purpose: Select a provider/model/adapter deterministically from versioned capability and performance evidence without performing a provider mutation.

scoring_policy.normalization: Each dimension is an integer 0..100. Weighted score is round(sum(dimension * weight) / 100).
scoring_policy.missing_evidence: A missing scored dimension receives zero; a missing hard-gate field blocks the candidate.

decision_rules: A selected route contains exactly one provider, model, adapter, cost estimate, catalog version and evidence list.
Fallback order is advisory only. It does not authorize another paid attempt.
A catalog or pricing change produces a new route decision version and requires a fresh budget reservation before submission.
Provider success does not imply artifact acceptance, continuity approval or creative approval.
Historical acceptance and cost signals may influence scoring only when their sample window, count and catalog/model version are recorded.
The router never grants greenlight, spend escalation, retry, creative acceptance or publication approval.

adapter_contract.secret_handling: Only logical credential references cross the router boundary.
